sloka: इह प्राप्तान्वयम् सर्वान् शत्रूम्स्तव महाबल ।वशे शस्त्रप्रतापेन करिष्यामो न सम्शयः ॥६-१३-८॥।।
transliteration: iha prāptānvayam sarvān śatrūmstava mahābala ।vaśe śastrapratāpena kariṣyāmo na samśayaḥ ॥6-13-8॥।।

translations.english: "O Ravana of extraordinary strength We will bring all your enemies under control on their arrival here. There is no doubt."
